provenance: The pinned standards registry and the reviewed vendor register Feature Kickoff checks against, in both modes. Standards are pinned to the version named here and never recalled from a model's memory; a standard with no pinned version reads as not checked. Vendors are added by the partnership owner after reading the vendor's published docs, with the date they were read. Change this file by pull request, reviewed by the architecture owner.
